diagram_math_checks.evidence: The local definition gives left-justified rows. The drawn row lengths are 6,5,3,2,1 from top to bottom, exactly 17 unit cells. The square occupies columns 1–3 in rows 1–3, α occupies rows 1–2 to its right with lengths 3,2, and β occupies rows 4–5 below it with lengths 2,1. No lower-right cells occur.
λ₃=3≥3 and λ₄=2<4, so the local Durfee-length definition gives k=3. The blue region contains exactly 3×3=9 cells; no 4×4 square is possible.

α=(3,2) has two≤3 rows, while β=(2,1) has all parts≤3. Attaching these pieces as in proof step 1.1 reconstructs exactly (6,5,3,2,1). Label arrows point into their respective orange/green regions and assert no extra relation.

|α|=5 and |β|=3, so |λ|=9+5+3=17 and x^17=x^9 x^5 x^3. Proof step 2.1 and local Fact L2 justify the two independent restricted-partition generating functions ∏(1−x^i)^−1 and the square factor x^(k²). The illustration introduces no new hypothesis and is unnecessary for proof steps 1.1–3.1.
